name: Kinetics-700
description: A large-scale video action-recognition dataset consisting of short clips sourced from YouTube and annotated with human action labels.
citation: Carreira, J., Noland, E., Hillier, C., & Zisserman, A. (2019). A Short Note on the Kinetics-700 Human Action Dataset. arXiv:1907.06987. https://arxiv.org/abs/1907.06987
